auth_mode_evidence.auth_mode_resolution_note: All three environments set ODP_AUTH_MODE=local and none sets ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED. shared/auth/mode.py:92-105 makes ODP_AUTH_MODE authoritative and an empty legacy flag non-conflicting, so the resolved mode is 'local' with no error and the OIDC-only branch at product_ops/deployment/validate_cloud_run_live_deployment.py:1434-1435 never executes. OIDC/OAuth inputs are therefore classified as not_applicable for runtime live deployment preflight; this preflight does not ask for OIDC to be enabled, while historical 2026-08-25 PROD-GCP-04 text is preserved.

gcp_staging_execution_preflight.runtime_readback_reason: Every gcloud probe in this run was issued as oday-dev-runtime@alfaloop-data-project-2.iam.gserviceaccount.com (quota project alfaloop-data-project-2 #323781672261), which is not the release identity. Probes returned Cloud Resource Manager disabled, ambiguous not-found/unauthorized, or PERMISSION_DENIED. None of these establish the target's existence, its configuration, or the release identity's access. Physical resource/IAM state remains unknown pending authorized readback with release identity. References alone do not prove live resources or Human GO; failed probes do not prove nonexistence.
